## Multi-year vnStat import performance

- Multi-year vnStat imports now use a dense, lock-verified same-shape update
  path with a cardinality-aware PostgreSQL plan. The savepoint fallback keeps
  raw samples, rollups, hourly data, revisions, epochs, and job lineage atomic.
- Monitoring reads use bounded, exact range/bucket plans across resource,
  network, Ping, traffic, and system telemetry. Authorized cards, snapshots,
  and detail reads coalesce for a one-second post-completion window, with
  telemetry invalidation; no Redis dependency is required.
- Shared-view edits are previewed and compare-and-swap safe, including
  authoritative target-refresh revisions. Private and shared cards support
  explicit raw/ratio metric sorting with deterministic missing-value handling.
